lyrics.text: ~ Intro ~
You get a shiver in the dark...
South of the river you stop...
A band is blowing Dixie...
You feel alright when you hear the music ring
You step inside but you don't see too many faces...
Coming in out of the rain...
Too much competition, too many other places
But not too many horns can make that sound
~ Way on down south, London town ~
~ Chord vamp ~
You check out Guitar George, he knows all the chords...
Strictly rhythm, he doesn't want to make it cry...
An old guitar is all he can afford
When he gets up under the lights to play his thing
Harry doesn't mind if he doesn't make the scene...
He's got a daytime job, he's doing alright
He can play honky tonk just like anything
Saving it up for Friday night
~ With the Sultans... with the Sultans of Swing ~
~ Guitar Solo ~
And then the man steps right up to the microphone...
Thank you goodnight, now it's time to go home
He makes it fast with one more thing
~ We are the Sultans... we are the Sultans of Swing ~
~ Outro ~
